2 Ye shall not add unto the word which I command you, neither shall ye diminish ought from it, that ye may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you. (Deuteronomy 4:2 KJV)

Even though this is Old Testament Scripture, where God was warning Israel not to add to, or take away, from His word, I believe that God is saying the same thing to us under the New Testament. Religion has been bad to ignore, or take away, from a lot of the Scriptures in our new covenant. The Apostle John gives a very stern warning in the book of Revelations (Revelation 22:19) about adding to, or taking away, from his prophesy, so I think we all need to be very careful in adding to, or taking away, from the Word of God in any way at all. If we do believe that the Word of God is true and complete (2 Timothy 3:16), then why would we want to change it? Remember that there is only one God, and you are not Him.

Jesus warned us that man tended to make the Word of God of none effect through our traditions (Mark 7:13, Matthew 15:6). It has been said that people don’t let the Word of God get in the way of what they believe, but that should not be so. The bible tells us to make God’s Word above any of man’s words (Romans 3:4). Let us all be very careful to not change the Word as given to us by our Lord. Let us praise and worship our Lord in all we do and say (Psalms 100:4).
